note: The fictional persona Kavya Raman's target list for the v0.2.0 worked run. The student chose the list (2026-10-19): five large employers whose careers sites the engine cannot read, plus seven comparable companies with Greenhouse boards it can read. Claude Code wrote the file and listed the legal names, so they are model-judgment; the board slugs were checked against each board's public API on 2026-10-19. time_to_start is the person's declared expected time to start, in weeks, with a reason; until it is declared, a company's postings hold on timing. Updated 2026-10-19 with the student's own words, transcribed verbatim by Claude Code: time_to_start (22 weeks for all seven, with the student's reason) and a confirmed company_identity for each of the seven. The student also wrote: "I’ll replace the default when a posting specifies a start date or a recruiter provides a clearer timeline. A fixed new-grad cohort needs its own check; a “2027” title does not establish that the start falls within Kavya’s window." and "FAANG companies remain part of my search even when their careers sites need a separate manual check."
